correctness.rationale: For fixed N>=2, m>=2, r,D>0 the marked Poisson process splits into independent both-reset c, and exclusive e,e clocks, with pair ages A_i=min(E_c,E_i); exact diagonal age mass c exp[-(2lambda-c)t] and off-diagonal density e lambda exp[-e min(s,t)-lambda max(s,t)]. Conditional Gaussian tails and a strict saddle t*=x/sqrt(2D(2lambda-c)) give P(X1>x,X2>x)~[(2lambda-c)/(c sqrt(2pi z))] exp(-z), z=x sqrt(2(2lambda-c)/D). The off-diagonal O(1) boundary layer gives Exp(c/2) absolute gap, weight (c/(2lambda-c))^2 on a common-last-event atom; ages/x concentrate, whereas c=0 yields independent Laplace tails and Gaussian sqrt(x) gap. Independently re-integrated marked age mixture for c=.5,.9 and high x and checked limiting shared-clock weight and sharp prefactor. n,m and thresholds fixed; this is not a uniform c->0 claim.
